storage_scope.filesystem: Local Windows filesystem supporting CreateFileW create-new semantics and named mutexes.
storage_scope.mount_boundary: Each authority is limited to one resolved root; Local named-mutex serialization is limited to one Windows session; pathname-based replacement is not claimed as a guarantee by this profile.

limitations: cross_process_serialization is limited to cooperating processes in one Windows session because the implementation uses a Local named mutex.
Namespace components are checked for reparse points but mutations are pathname-based and parent identity replacement is not detected; namespace_bound_mutation is not provided.
Parent-directory fsync is unavailable in this implementation; namespace_metadata_flush_attempted is not provided.
Pathname-based replacement is not claimed as atomic_replace.
No process-crash recovery or power-loss durability guarantee is claimed.
